name: Canonical visual launch roadmap and sprint documentation system
acceptanceCriteria: One canonical visual launch roadmap distinguishes repository integration, production verification, controlled alpha, launch clearance, public launch, and future non-launch lanes.
SPRINT.md contains only the reviewed implementation baseline, sprint outcome, active workstreams, execution order, non-goals, blockers, and definition of done.
A documentation authority map identifies canonical live truth, architecture contracts, evidence, research, and the required handling of stale planning documents.
README.md, CURRENT_STATUS.md, and strategy documentation point to the same launch roadmap without promoting planned L4 or L5 work into launch scope.
Automated contract tests fail when canonical launch links, privacy boundaries, evidence distinctions, or L4/L5 gates disappear.
